{{Quote|A bounty hunter I worked with used 'stims to keep in shape. When he retired&mdash;and stopped using the myostims&mdash;his body just fell apart. He's still hooked into life support computers in the Avenel Rest Station medical wing.|Gyaxx, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark" />}}
The '''Avenel Rest Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="Gundark" /> located within an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Avenel system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The station was equipped with a [[Medic/Legends|medical]] wing.<ref name="Gundark" />

By the date [[6 ABY/Legends|41:3:1:10]], a former [[Unidentified bounty hunter (myostims)|bounty hunter]] was a patient in the medical wing of the station. He was connected to [[Life support/Legends|life support]] [[Computer/Legends|computers]] due to having had a severe case of muscle atrophy after prolonged use of [[Myostim unit|myostim]] muscle-massaging units. The [[Hunting/Legends|hunter's]] former partner, [[Gyaxx]], later mentioned the Avenel Rest Station in the illegal database ''[[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]''.<ref name="Gundark" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Avenel Rest Station was first mentioned in the [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', which was published for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Gundark" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] containing the station in grid square O-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
